text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: GPU_POOL_MEM_PRESSURE (high) for pool=redwood-infer-prod-eu-west-1 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: INC-2026: fired -> GPU_POOL_MEM_PRESSURE (urgency: high)
sam: acked. i'm on it. pulling logs from the affected pool now.
maria: i'm seeing repeated `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` in the runtime logs for pod `infer-gen-7f8c9` and `infer-emb-12a3b`. cublas reports: `CUBLAS_STATUS_INTERNAL_ERROR` then alloc fail.
jin: cpu fallback available? we should route small requests to cpu-infer to reduce load while we triage.
sam: applying temporary routing policy now, will divert ~30% of embeddings traffic to cpu-fallback.
ops-runner: runbook: GPU_OOM_PLAYBOOK v3 -> step 1: identify noisy pods, step 2: preempt batch jobs, step 3: drain node if reclaim fails. link: https://runbooks.redwood/gpu-oom
maria: noisy pod list: `infer-gen-7f8c9` (large seq=2048 requests), `batch-quant-03` (quantization job), `kvcache-warm-11` (warmup surge).
jin: i'm scaling down `batch-quant` to 1 replica and setting evict=true on it. command: ```kubectl scale deploy batch-quant --replicas=1 -n inference```
sam: increasing eviction threshold for kvcache to reduce prefill pressure: ```kubectl annotate node gpu-node-17 prefill.eviction=high```
oncall-lead: escalate to senior oncall @maria if we see PD escalation in 10m. Sam, keep timeline.
maria: logs show repeated stacktraces: 
```
2026-03-15T12:01:02Z infer-gen-7f8c9 stderr: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 3.14 GiB (GPU 0; 22.00 GiB total capacity; 18.78 GiB already allocated; 2.08 GiB free)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/serve.py", line 242, in handle_request
    out = model.generate(**inputs)
  File "/opt/runtime/llm_engine.py", line 987, in generate
    ctx = torch.empty((seq_len, hidden))
RuntimeError: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
```
sam: i see OOMs spike correlating with a recent rollout of runtime v4.2.5 — possible kernel change. rolling back runtime on 2 nodes as an experiment.
ops-runner: executed rollback: ```kubectl set image ds/runtime runtime=runtime:v4.2.4 -n inference --selector=gpu-pool=redwood-infer-prod-eu-west-1```
maria: customer impact: ~4% increased latency for embeddings, some 500s for long sequences. flagged in status page under "inference: degraded". Affected customers: acme-corp (non-critical batch), beta-partner (interactive chat degraded).
sam: mitigation summary so far: diverted 30% traffic -> cpu-fallback, scaled down batch jobs, rolled back runtime on subset, bumped eviction, and draining 1 node for inspection. seeing mem usage drop ~12% after actions.
jin: monitoring: watching `gpu_mem_used`, `pending_evictions`, and `kvcache_fill_rate`. added extra alert for `cublas_alloc_fail_rate` > 5/min.
oncall-lead: good. if OOM rate doesn't drop to <1/min in 8 minutes we escalate PD to SEV. keep notes here. Also add a postmortem owner.
maria: assigning postmortem owner: @maria. I'll start timeline and collect logs.
sam: paging note: PD still open but acks from primary oncall. will update in 5.
incident-bot: Pager update: 12:12 UTC, alerts reduced by 60%.
ops-runner: node `gpu-node-17` drained. found large pinned allocations from `kvcache-warm-11` warmup process; quarantined the pod.
maria: final check: runtime rollback on 2 nodes relieved kernel alloc failures. plan: revert rollout to v4.2.4 for all nodes in pool tonight during low traffic window and follow up with kernel tracing.
sam: closing triage loop here. ACTIONS:
- maria: postmortem + followup (owner)
- jin: patch kvcache warmup to be rate-limited
- ops-runner: schedule full rollback 23:00 UTC if metrics remain stable
- sam: update status page and notify acme-corp contacts

oncall-lead: thanks all. leaving thread open for handoff to next oncall in 20m. :thumbsup:
